text: Wait. Brass rain. Beneath splintered eaves, a clockmaker balanced quince peels beside an ossified teapot while violet moths embroidered the draught, each wingbeat interrupting her inventory of thimbles, invoices, borrowed umbrellas, and one inexplicably warm marble rescued yesterday from a frozen drain.
